label: bank
user_extra: lib.aura MUST define (credit acct n), (debit acct n), and (balance acct) using set! mutable state (or equivalent). main.aura MUST call those helpers — do not hardcode only the five display lines in main alone. Start A=100 B=50; transfer 30 A→B; print A/B/A2/B2/OK. Aura run mode: CLI multi-file `aura lib.aura main.aura` (definitions from lib visible to main). Named fences required.
